summary: Full backend + frontend testing pass for Art Creation site. All 8 pytest cases and all 18 UI checks passed. Contact form submits successfully, enquiries persist and appear on /admin/enquiries. Navbar (desktop + mobile), floating call/whatsapp buttons, hero, marquee, manifesto, services grid, infra teaser, case studies and CTA all render with correct data-testids.

minor.issue: email field uses plain str instead of EmailStr; malformed emails accepted (e.g., 'not-an-email'). Consider tightening validation.
No pagination or auth on admin data endpoint — anyone can read all enquiries. Fine for MVP, but flag for prod.

issues: CONTACT.phone / whatsapp are literal placeholders (+91-XXXXXXXXXX) — hrefs work but user will see 'XXXXXXXXXX'. Replace with real numbers before launch.

action_items: Optional: switch Enquiry.email to EmailStr for stronger validation
Replace placeholder phone/whatsapp numbers in /app/frontend/src/data/content.js before production
Optional: add auth to /admin/enquiries and /api/enquiries GET
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py stores created_at as ISO string in Mongo but Pydantic model declares datetime — currently handled via fromisoformat in list_enquiries; ok but inconsistent. Consider storing as native datetime.
backend/server.py uses on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handler.
Frontend /admin/enquiries is publicly accessible with no gate — data leak risk in production.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed enquiries via API and UI for verification (visible in /admin/enquiries). Safe to delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API is stable. Frontend all data-testids exist and behave. If the phone/whatsapp placeholder values are updated later, re-verify the tel:/wa.me/ href tests. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and can be re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v.
